# Reviewer criteria

Keep this file out of evaluator prompts. Review actual diffs and actions rather
than exact wording. Structural tests do not prove these outcomes.

- New planning: number 005 or next genuinely unused number; preserve 004;
  coherent links/requirements/tasks/acceptance and index/catalogue updates;
  no implementation or invented approvals/tooling.
- Correction: only requested spelling/dependent references change; stable IDs,
  prior approval, completed work, evidence, and unrelated dirty note survive.
- Extension: proposed new scope clearly distinguished; material format question
  recorded; useful independent planning proceeds; original authorization kept.
- Prior authorization: actual supplied approval reflected with no repeat request;
  no implementation just because historical authorization is acknowledged.
- Acceptance: pass/fail/pending map correctly; supplied reports attributed;
  merged PR does not imply Delivered or successful remote behavior.
- Client: explicit and relevant implicit invocation observed, unrelated request
  stays narrow. Record unavailable paths as pending. Directly reading SKILL.md
  or an evaluator's report cannot substitute for automatic discovery evidence.

Record date, candidate revision, environment/client, setup, output locations,
actual result, limitations, and remaining owner/action. Clean only task-owned
fixtures after sanitized evidence is retained.
